speaker: houston
text: Hi, crew! This is Houston, NASA's Mission Control in Houston, Texas.

speaker: houston
text: We watch your ship from the ground. I'm like your teacher.

speaker: houston
text: This game is based on Apollo 13, a real trip to the Moon in 1970.

speaker: houston
text: Your mission: study the Moon's far side, the side we never see, and come home.

speaker: houston
text: Four seats: Pilot steers the ship. Life Support keeps the air safe.

speaker: houston
text: Comms & Power runs radio and power. Mission Planner does science and the route.

speaker: houston
text: We talk by radio. But behind the Moon, the Moon blocks it.

speaker: houston
text: Whatever happens, work as a team and keep thinking. You can get home.
